input.quote: 11.1 Upon expiry or termination for any reason, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six months at the rates in the expiring Order Form. Assistance includes knowledge transfer, export support, cooperation with a replacement supplier, orderly migration, and continued service at the then-current scope and service levels.
input.rationale: Section 11 meets the preferred position in full: six months of transition assistance on Customer's request (at the expiring Order Form rates, which is better for us than "then-current rates"), return of all Customer Data in a complete, commonly used, documented, machine-readable format within thirty days, and secure deletion with written officer certification. Deletion is triggered only after Customer confirms successful return, and Vendor may not withhold Customer Data over a fee dispute, so the walk-away risks (no data return, immediate deletion, assistance conditioned on payment) are absent. Section 10.1 preserves access through the agreed transition period and Section 15 imposes no conflicting deletion timing. No redline needed.
